title: Projects
text:
Perhaps unsurprisingly for someone of my professional interests, I am a huge Dungeons & Dragons () fan in my free time. To blend my personal and professional interests I’ve created this package to serve any other people in the R / DnD Venn Diagram intersection. It allows for easy rolling of dice, creation of character statistics, and (for GMs) encounter balancing. This package is also a fun chance for me to practice my coding skills in a risk-free environment. A version of this package is available on CRAN here.
To help showcase some of the functions in dndR I’ve created a standalone Quarto website that is similar to a vignette. Feel free to check it out!
